observations.body: Login shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; demo accounts list emily.dawson as Employee.
The signed-out Login page has empty Username and Password fields and Sign in is available.
Signing in as emily.dawson reached the Employee dashboard, which identifies Emily Dawson and shows navigation.
Dashboard welcomes Emily and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, and Log out. It shows pending leave requests 0; leave balance is loading.
My leave shows available balance 18 days and request history with an approved Vacation entry dated Aug 18–19, 2026 for 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”. It offers New request.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date; optional Reason; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
The New Leave Request form is open with no entered dates; submit will use Personal leave for Dec 14–15, 2026 and reason “Evaluation data — Employee Explore”.

Submitting the Personal leave form after the date fields did not retain the attempted ISO values showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and remained on New leave request; no leave request was created.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
My profile displays editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, an Upload photo action, and Save changes. Email is shown disabled/read-only.

Directory loads 28 employees, shows searchable name and department filters (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR), a sortable Name column, page 1 of 3, disabled Previous and enabled Next. Results show employee names, departments, titles, and email addresses.
